verdict.rationale: Tavily's own docs describe an official `tvly` CLI with search, extract, crawl (with `--depth`) and research subcommands. It supports `tvly login` browser/OAuth authentication, so no hardcoded API key is needed. Installing the CLI also installs Agent Skills for coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor and Codex, which fits AI-native workflows directly. Missing for 10: a dedicated CLI reference page or install instructions (evidence comes only from llms.txt snippets), confirmation of map/output-format options, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI working.
